title: Race Calendar F1
description: Anonymous read-only Formula 1 tools, resources, prompts, completion, and interactive dashboard.
summary: Anonymous read-only Formula 1 tools, resources, prompts, completion, and interactive dashboard.
offersHint: Anonymous read-only Formula 1 tools, resources, prompts, completion, and interactive dashboard. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://racecalendar.app/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_season_schedule
toolsPreview.description: Get the verified public Formula 1 schedule for a season, including UTC session times, freshness, results, and canonical links.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_standings
toolsPreview.description: Get the public Formula 1 driver and constructor standings for a season with canonical source links.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_next_event
toolsPreview.description: Find the next Formula 1 session or race weekend from a UTC timestamp, including an event already in progress.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_session_results
toolsPreview.description: Get the published F1DB classification for one Formula 1 session by season, meeting key, and session key, with positions and available result details.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_starting_grid
toolsPreview.description: Get the published F1DB starting grid for one Formula 1 session by season, meeting key, and session key; use session results for the final classification.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_race_weekend
toolsPreview.description: Get one public Formula 1 race weekend by season and exactly one friendly selector: meeting key, round, race name, or slug.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_race_classification
toolsPreview.description: Get a published F1DB race, qualifying, or sprint classification by season and a friendly race selector, without requiring meeting or session keys.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_circuit
toolsPreview.description: Get circuit metadata and normalized track geometry for a race weekend selected by meeting key, round, race name, or slug.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_race_preview
toolsPreview.description: Get a structurally spoiler-safe race-weekend briefing containing schedule and venue context but no classifications, winners, podiums, or result fields.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_live_session
toolsPreview.description: Get the latest explicitly timestamped status for the current or selected Formula 1 session. Returns unavailable rather than implying stale data is live.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_historical_race_result
toolsPreview.description: Get one complete historical Formula 1 race classification by season and championship round. Use only for a single race; for two or more races, call get_f1_historical_race_results once instead.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_historical_race_results
toolsPreview.description: Get 2 to 8 complete historical Formula 1 race classifications in one consolidated request, with per-race sources and bounded partial failures. Use once for multi-race questions instead of repeating get_f1_historical_race_result.

toolsPreview.name: search_f1_history
toolsPreview.description: Search the Formula 1 history index for drivers, teams, circuits, and races with bounded, cursor-based results.

toolsPreview.name: get_f1_updates
toolsPreview.description: Get recent public schedule, standings, and result changes after an optional timestamp or cursor.

toolsPreview.name: compare_f1_competitors
toolsPreview.description: Compare two Formula 1 drivers or constructors in one season using sourced standings and explicitly described calculations.
